title: CoMet: Context and Multiplicity Decomposition for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2606.32012v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Uncertainty estimation has been a long-standing challenge in AI models; it amounts to "knowing what you don't know," and metacognition is notoriously difficult even for humans (cf. the Dunning-Kruger effect). Although it is still far from solved even in simpler classification systems, tackling it in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is becoming increasingly important. Within MLLMs, uncertainty can stem from any of the diverse sources as well as from their relationships, and further can stem from the unbounded answers in the open-ended setting. To tackle the issues, we propose CoMet, an MLLM uncertainty estimation method by decomposing uncertainty into a context-specific term and a multiplicity-specific term. The former captures ambiguity induced by the given context (e.g., task or prompt), while the latter captures how many plausible answers determined by the context remain compatible with the given input. translated_title: CoMet：面向多模态不确定性估计的上下文与多样性分解
translated_abstract: 不确定性估计是人工智能模型中长期存在的挑战；它相当于“知道自己不知道什么”，而元认知即使对人类而言也是出了名的困难（参见邓宁-克鲁格效应）。尽管即使在较简单的分类系统中这一问题仍远未解决，但在多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中解决这一问题正变得日益重要。在MLLM中，不确定性可能来自各种不同的来源及其相互关系，在开放式设定下，还可能来自无界的答案空间。为解决这些问题，我们提出了CoMet，一种将不确定性分解为上下文特定项和多样性特定项的MLLM不确定性估计方法。前者捕捉由给定上下文（例如任务或提示）所引起的歧义，后者捕捉由上下文所确定的、与给定输入保持相容的合理答案的数量。我们训练一个轻量……
tldr: 提出CoMet方法，通过将多模态大语言模型的不确定性分解为上下文特定项（捕捉给定任务或提示引起的歧义）和多样性特定项（捕捉与之相容的合理答案数量），从而在开放式多模态场景下实现不确定性估计。
en_tdlr: CoMet proposes estimating uncertainty in MLLMs by decomposing it into a context-specific term capturing ambiguity from the given task/prompt and a multiplicity-specific term capturing the number of plausible answers compatible with the input, enabling uncertainty estimation in open-ended multimodal settings.
